title: 14-Day POC Metrics Validation
dependencies: VS-07 bounded POC scheduler merged through PR #13
Discovery Kernel main push CI enabled

notes: VS-07 measures the approved PRD 14-day discovery-engine POC gates using reproducible daily evidence.
Missing or partial daily evidence fails closed and cannot silently count as a passing day; complete failing days remain evidence.
Every accepted daily record is bound to an exact repository SHA and GitHub Actions run ID.

Product owner approved seven additive household-value POC categories before Day 1: grocery/supermarket, restaurant/takeaway, family/kids, activities, senior discounts, pharmacy/personal care, and spa/wellness.
The new source pack is POC-only, robots-governed, low-rate, attribution-required and factual-metadata-only; raw page/image retention remains prohibited.
Each newly approved source has minimum_candidates=1 so HTTP success with zero extracted inventory fails closed.

Existing restrictions remain unchanged: McDonald's and Pizza Hut denied, Franks denied, Wolt partner-only, and the original Lidl source remains research-only; a separate explicit Lidl POC key carries the approved narrow POC permission.
Deal.mt remains reference/validation inventory only and Corinthia is not approved for automated acquisition because published terms prohibit automated monitoring without consent.
Product owner approved a bounded daily POC scheduler for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-14 at 08:00 Europe/Malta; scheduled runs force scope=poc and cannot select production scope.
Release and production enablement remain not authorized.
The measurement framework's prior certification remains historical evidence but is stale for this runtime source-policy/catalog amendment until the amendment exact head is re-certified.

approvals.rationale: Product owner approved VS-07 measurement, the bounded scheduler, and explicitly approved adding the seven household-value POC categories before Day 1 with 'Approved, lets add these'.

Product owner approved the additive POC-only source policies for grocery/supermarket, restaurant/takeaway, family/kids, activities, senior discounts, pharmacy/personal care and spa/wellness under the documented narrow public-path, robots, rate-cap, attribution and no-content-retention constraints. Existing VS-04/VS-06 restrictions and production denial remain authoritative.
Product owner authorized implementation of the seven approved household-value POC categories and the extraction/catalog hardening required to test them before the formal Day 1 run.

Product owner approved the original VS-07 measurement framework certification after exact-head Discovery Kernel, PES preflight, PostgreSQL/PostGIS/pgvector integration and POC metric regression tests passed. This certification is historical evidence and does not certify the current household source amendment.

evidence: household source amendment requires fresh exact-head certification

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Demonstrate over fourteen consecutive complete measurement days that Ziras meets the approved Malta discovery-engine POC gates without merchant onboarding.
